description: This Java source file defines the class "RomRaiderWrapper" which serves as a wrapper to initialize and start the RomRaider ECU tuning application, and to load a specific ECU configuration file.

classes.name: RomRaiderWrapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to initialize and start the RomRaider ECU tuning application and load configurations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that starts RomRaider and loads the 'rusefi_configuration.bin' ECU configuration.

methods.name: startRomRaider
methods.description: Initializes the environment, sets up UI, and returns an ECUEditor instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Configures settings and loads the specific ECU definition file, and initializes debug logging.
